artworks.title: A Sketch of the Embankment
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched scene from an elevated perspective with several figures and faintly drawn structures. The horizon includes rooftops and spires, hinting at an urban or village landscape. The sketch is minimalistic with sparse, quick linear strokes outlining people and buildings. The color palette is muted in cream and gray tones, giving the piece a subtle quality. Closest to us are sketchy impressions of people standing and seated, defined by few lines. In the background, faint indications of architecture add depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Little Steps, Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an exterior architectural scene with a focus on a building entrance. The drawing consists of loose pencil or ink strokes outlining the details of the scene. There is a hint of a doorway at the center, with stairs leading up to it. Faint outlines suggest windows and possibly a railing on either side of the entrance. The drawing captures a street-side view in an impressionistic style that focuses on the essence of the scene rather than precise details. The composition conveys a sense of a fleeting moment, likely intended as a quick study sketch.

artworks.title: T.A. Nash's Fruit-Shop
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a downward perspective of a busy scene below. A market stall's canopy is seen at the top of the image with the inscription "T. A. Nash" on it. The brushwork consists of sketch-like lines conveying movement. The color palette is monochrome with light and dark tones. Figures are depicted in casual stances near us, while vendors and their goods are further away.

artworks.title: The Fish-Shop, Busy Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene featuring buildings with storefronts. The artwork captures a row of three-story buildings with awnings over some of the doorways. The upper floors show windows, some open, allowing a peek into the interiors. The focus is on the lower level, where awnings suggest commercial activity. The storefront on the left appears inset with a small group gathered. The central and right sections of the facade similarly indicate bustling activity, with a canopy overhang shading individuals. Fine lines and loose sketchwork give the piece an impressionistic feel. The facade shows weathered textures, adding character to the architecture, evocative of a busy urban environment.

artworks.title: Woods's Fruit Shop
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 9.5 × 13.1 cm (3 3/4 × 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a storefront. The image depicts a shopfront with a sign reading "J.H. WOODS" and "Salesmen." The drawing shows a canopy overhead and an assortment of baskets and goods on display in front of the window. The scene is sketched with fine lines, giving texture and depth to the elements like baskets, goods, and awning. The drawing captures a bustling retail environment, including bins or baskets possibly filled with produce or similar items. The overall tone is monochromatic, relying on shading and line work to convey details and mood.

artworks.title: York Street, Westminster
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a storefront scene. It depicts a row of shop facades with signs and architectural details. The drawing shows two storefronts with signs that read "CHEESE" and "78" and "74." The image is rendered in a sketchy, line-oriented style with sparse lines and minimal shading, focusing on architectural outlines and hinted interior details like shelves with goods. The composition aims to capture a street view emphasizing building details and shop signs.

artworks.title: The Barber's
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with storefronts. Details of the shop window, figures, and architectural elements are depicted in fine lines. A streetlamp is also visible. The artwork is rendered in sepia tones, giving it an antique feel.

artworks.title: Rag-Shop, Milman's Row
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an exterior scene with draped fabrics and architectural details. The image includes a doorway flanked by hanging textiles, steps leading up to the entrance, and other architectural elements. The fine lines and shading create texture and depth, giving the facade a worn appearance. The style of the drawing captures the ambiance of a lived environment.

artworks.title: Justice Walk - Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street view of a building with a group of figures. The scene illustrates a row of buildings with a wrought iron fence in front, with figures seemingly engaged in social interaction on the sidewalk and in front of the doors. The building has windows with signage; one visible sign reads "C.W. BRETT & GARDINER." The drawing employs fine lines to convey details, including architectural elements of the building and the posture and gathering of figures. The overall atmosphere suggests an urban scene during a past era.

artworks.title: Bird-Cages Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a building. The view is straight on, showing various architectural details. There is a horizontal structure at the top suggesting part of a building. The drawing technique uses fine and sketchy lines for texture and definition. Figures are depicted loosely, with one standing on the left and a group conversing in the center. In the background, more figures are near a storefront labeled "W. Jones." The color scheme is monochrome, with dark lines on a light background.

artworks.title: Exeter Street
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a building facade in focus. The perspective is straight on, highlighting architectural details. The lines are delicate and sketch-like. The color palette is limited to sepia tones. Several figures are near the building, with objects inside and outside the shop. Windows on the building add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Bird-Cages, Drury Lane
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a darkened interior space with a figure holding a baby in front of a row of cages. The drawing depicts a sketched interior scene where a figure holds a smaller figure against a backdrop of a wall lined with cages. Above, a row of cages is visible, each containing abstract forms that could be animals or birds. The line work is loose and sketchy, giving an incomplete impression. The scene captures a moment of quiet and mystery, emphasized by heavy shadows and minimal detailing.

artworks.title: Marbles
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a shopfront with figures in front of it. The sketch features a storefront with a large window divided into several panes, some of which suggest decorative items. In front of the shop, several minimally detailed figures are depicted in various poses, possibly interacting with their surroundings. The style is quick and loose, giving an impressionistic view of a casual street scene.

artworks.title: Petticoat Lane
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing three figures - a woman and two children. The woman stands upright with one child beside her and the other seated slightly apart. The woman has her hair styled in a neat bun, while the children have short, tousled hair. They are wearing period-appropriate clothing. The woman appears to be holding a cloth or garment. The background includes a simple architectural element, possibly a window and door with crosshatched shading indicating shadows. The setting suggests an outdoor or courtyard environment with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Clothes Exchange, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a street view from an elevated position looking down a narrow, bustling urban alley. The horizon line is not visible as the alley leads the eye into the deeper part of the image where the street curves. The artwork features an etching style with fine lines outlining the architecture and figures, creating a sense of movement. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily using shades of beige and brown with variations achieved through hatching. The contrast draws attention to the lively activity of the people and the structural details of the buildings. Buildings line both sides of the street, with more detail toward the central area including awnings and groups of people.

artworks.title: Clothes Exchange, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban street scene. The image captures a busy street flanked by buildings on both sides. The street is bustling with activity, with various figures depicted in the foreground and midground. There are simple line drawings of animals walking along the street. The details are rendered in delicate and sketchy lines. The top right includes some signage.

artworks.title: Clothes Exchange, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an interior space reminiscent of a busy station or industrial building. The viewpoint is at eye level, showing structured arches, arched windows, and a grid-like pattern. The horizon is not visible due to architectural elements and people. The illustration style is sketch-like with loose brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia and cream tones. Figures are scattered, showing movement and daily life, with minimal detail. The building's features in the background add depth.

artworks.title: Fleur de Lys Passage
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an exhibition entrance featuring an alleyway leading to an archway with a sign reading "ENTRANCE TO THE EXIBITION. CLOTHES EXCHANGE." The sketchy lines outline structures and figures, including a hanging lantern. The scene indicates a busy marketplace with multiple figures suggesting movement and activity. The sketch style depicts a moment in time.

artworks.title: Saint James's Place, Hounsditch
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene captured from a slightly elevated perspective, offering a wide view of the area. The horizon is positioned towards the upper third of the image, meeting the edges of the buildings. Atop one structure, the word "M. & E. Ceux." is visible. The image features fine and delicate brushstrokes with a sketched quality. The line work effectively conveys figures and architectural forms. The color palette is limited to beige and brown tones, typical of aged ink or paper. Several figures are suggested with light brushwork in the foreground, while denser lines are used for stores and facades in the distance.

artworks.title: Cutler Street, Hounsditch
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene viewed from a slight elevation. Buildings line the street, and people are visible at various distances. To the left, there is a shaded area with a sign reading "ABRAHAMS." The technique used is etching, creating a sketch-like quality with light strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, with brown tones.

artworks.title: Melon-Shop, Hounsditch
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with multiple figures inside a room and two seated individuals outside beneath a window. The people inside are facing forward, appearing to be behind a counter or desk with various items around them. Their facial features are somewhat indistinct and they have short, roughly styled hair. The figures outside are seated side by side, showing upper body details and similar facial features with simple, tidy hairstyles. They wear clothing that suggests turn-of-the-century fashion. There is no jewelry or objects held by the figures. The background is rendered with a textured, cross-hatched style, depicting shelves and creating a sense of depth in the enclosed environment.

artworks.title: After the Sale, Hounsditch
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of several figures. In the center, there is a woman standing with hands on hips. She is wearing a long dress with long sleeves and an apron, with a scarf or head covering. To her right are an adult and two children sitting on a lower level or bench. The adult and children are minimally detailed, with facial features highlighting nose and mouth outlines and short hair. Their clothing is loosely sketched. In the background, there is an abstract representation of a room with rough, expressive lines. The setting appears to be an interior space against a textured background.

artworks.title: Steps, Gray's Inn
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a park scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is high up, with small figures on a path or promenade. Closer to the viewer, there are seated figures, including adults and children. The etching features sparse lines and a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic, with the lines in a dark hue. Elements in the middle and distance, such as trees and figures, are depicted with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Long Seats, Gray's Inn
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The point of view in this image is at eye-level. The horizon line is not clearly defined but seems to be indicated by the line of figures seated on a bench towards the left half of the image. The brushstrokes are in a delicate, light sketching style with fine lines used to define the contours and details of the figures. The color palette is monochromatic, with light beige paper and dark-toned lines. The image depicts a group of people including women and children, some seated and others standing, with gentle details suggesting their attire and interactions. In the background, subtle outlines suggest additional figures. Some minimal detailing hints at architectural or natural elements.
